description: Leopold hooks: Stop-hook continuity, the PreToolUse git-lock guard, the PermissionRequest policy that answers a prompt for the session conducting the run (repeating the git lock's deny verbatim), the PreCompact/PostCompact checkpoint that composes .leopold/CHECKPOINT.md from durable state before a compaction and re-grounds the window after it, the StopFailure hook that ends a run whose turn died on an API error — no Stop fires for a failed turn, so nothing else would notice — the subagent ledger (SubagentStart/SubagentStop) with the PreToolUse cap that denies a spawn past max_subagents, and the PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure receipts that record when a command the brief calls verification ran and how it ended — the evidence 'done means verified' is checked against. Two more ride on what those receipts record: the PreToolUse edit gate and the TaskCompleted gate of done-gate.sh, which refuse a claim of done — a `- [ ]` turned into a `- [x]` in .leopold/PLAN.md, or a completed task — while nothing has verified the work since its last edit. Two more are Claude-Code-only, because Codex CLI 0.152.1 fires neither event: the FileChanged detector of file-watch.sh, which warns (never blocks) when .leopold/PLAN.md or .leopold/DECISIONS.md changes and the run did not write it, and the ConfigChange guard of config-guard.sh, which refuses a settings reload while a run is active — the run keeps the hook wiring it started with. All are no-ops unless a Leopold run is active in the project.
